descriptionHtml:
Meetion BTM032 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse White Edition (Dual Wireless Connection Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB / Silent Mute Buttons / Adjustable Optical DPI Sensor / Compact Ergonomic Design / Power-Saving Auto Sleep Mode / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Streamline your workspace and transition seamlessly across multiple devices with the Meetion BTM032 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse in clean White Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Featuring dual-mode connectivity via Bluetooth and a shared 2.4GHz USB nano receiver, this compact wireless mouse offers ultra-quiet silent clicking switches, an adjustable optical sensor, optimized power saving, and an ergonomic lightweight shape ideal for office, home, and travel use.
